subject: Get hands-on with Forté in Brighton East on 21 October
preheader: Practical mattress selection, pressure care and home trials. Join us or share with an OT colleague.
trialFooterText: Sleep Choice covers the seven-night in-home trial at no cost to the participant.
intro: Join Sleep Choice and Forté Healthcare on Wednesday 21 October for a practical morning exploring the mattresses behind your next recommendation.
Craig Gorman will bring static, hybrid and powered support surfaces together, with time to compare the technologies, discuss clinical applications and ask questions directly.
body: Explore pressure care fundamentals, pressure injury prevention and mattress selection across community, aged care and acute settings. The session includes real-world clinical applications, discussion and Q&A.

We're excited about our close working relationship with Forté. We'll also discuss Sleep Choice's flexible seven-night home trial pathway, and how OTs and clients can assess bed and mattress options in the environment where they will be used.

If bed and mattress prescription is becoming a bigger part of your work, we'd love you to join us. Team leaders, please share this with developing OTs who would benefit from seeing the range in person. Experienced clinicians are welcome too.
